{{Top|leg}}
'''Thermo-converters''' were used to convert heat into energy. [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] made extensive use of thermo-converters manufactured by [[Helthen Company/Legends|Helthen Company]] that were made of the alloy [[Tursturin/Legends|tursturin]].
